title: [Shopify] Initialize return processing for existing shops on upgrade
summary: A per-company upgrade step sets Process Returns As to Credit Memo for existing Shopify shops that still hold the uninitialized 0 (Quote) value, so refunds no longer create sales quotes. Credit Memo and Return Order settings are kept as they are.
key_points: Adds per-company upgrade migration to change only Quote/0 values to Credit Memo in existing shops
Preserves valid Credit Memo and Return Order selections already configured by users
Registers upgrade tag for new companies to prevent duplicate migrations
Includes two regression tests for migration behavior and upgrade-tag guard logic
Does not repair sales quotes already created before upgrade
